svg.title: Recovery is more than redirecting traffic
svg.desc: A conceptual recovery sequence detects and contains failure, establishes safe data authority while fencing old writers, reconciles state and replays durable work, then verifies invariants and capacity before reopening. Cached browsing can remain available where its contract permits. Pending operations are not confirmations. The exact order and parallel work depend on the protocol and runbook.
svg.text: Recovery restores trust, not just connectivity
Conceptual checkpoints; the protocol determines the exact runbook.
Bound retries; protect capacity; mark uncertain operations pending.
Use valid quorum / ownership; fence old writers before reopening writes.
Catch up data; resolve conflicts; check payment IDs; drain durable work.
Validate invariants, data loss, recovery time, and surviving capacity.
Cached browsing may continue; critical writes need their own safe path.
